ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the DX-5,
Downtown Mixed-Use District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 6-E in the

area bound by:

East Cermak Road; the west right-of-way line of the Chicago Transit Authority Railroad;
a line 145 feet south of and parallel to East Cermak Road; and South State Street,

to those of a DR-5, Downtown Residential District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

Par Vaal)

Pat Dowell
Alderman, 3 Ward

Common Address:
2201 S. State Street
